gui.llmjs.title: LLM Console
gui.llmjs.tab.log.tip: Inspect the actual requests, responses, completion status, and timing recorded by LLM Core.
gui.llmjs.tab.budget.tip: Review your token allowance; owners can inspect all player and principal usage.
gui.llmjs.tab.providers.tip: Review configured providers, connection status, models, and masked credentials.
gui.llmjs.tab.routing.tip: Choose provider priority and generation limits for each registered purpose.
gui.llmjs.tab.test.tip: Send a simple prompt or replay a purpose-aware request handed off by another mod.
gui.llmjs.tab.setup.tip: Add a provider or edit its endpoint, protocol format, model, and API key.
gui.llmjs.budget.confirm.tip: Acknowledge that players without an override may use unlimited tokens. Usage is still recorded.
gui.llmjs.budget.confirm.warning: PLAYER BUDGET DEFAULT: UNLIMITED — REVIEW AND CONFIRM
gui.llmjs.budget.title: Token usage and authorization
gui.llmjs.budget.default.fallback: Default budget configuration failed to load; inherited player access is disabled.
gui.llmjs.budget.admin.tip: This is a read-only projection. Use /llm budget default|set|reset to change authoritative state.
gui.llmjs.budget.overview.tip: This is a read-only projection. Only the server owner can change budget limits or usage.
gui.llmjs.budget.self.tip: Only your own aggregate is visible. Token budgets are managed by the server owner.
gui.llmjs.validation.purpose_required: Purpose is required when using purpose routing
gui.llmjs.parameter.temperature.tip: Enter 0..2. Leave blank to inherit; invalid or out-of-range values block Send/Save and show an error.
gui.llmjs.parameter.max_output.tip: Enter 1..1,000,000 output tokens. Leave blank to inherit; invalid values block Send/Save and show an error.
gui.llmjs.parameter.timeout.tip: Enter 1..3,600 seconds. Leave blank to inherit; invalid values block Send/Save and show an error.
gui.llmjs.parameter.input_budget.tip: Enter 1..2,000,000 input tokens, or leave blank to inherit. The provider context minus output reserve is still the effective cap.
gui.llmjs.parameter.output_reserve.tip: Enter 0..1,000,000 reserved output tokens. Leave blank to inherit; invalid values block Send/Save and show an error.
gui.llmjs.test.purpose.tip: Registered request purpose used to resolve its provider chain and generation limits. Press Tab to cycle matching purposes.
gui.llmjs.test.provider_chain.tip: Explicit provider priority, separated by commas or >. It is used only in Explicit mode; press Tab to complete provider names.
gui.llmjs.test.prompt.tip: In Simple mode this is the user message. For a handed-off request, it replaces only the final user text while preserving compiled context.
gui.llmjs.test.mode.tip: Purpose resolves the saved route for the purpose. Explicit uses the provider chain entered below and bypasses that chain selection.
gui.llmjs.test.vision.tip: Probe whether the first explicitly entered provider accepts a minimal image request. This does not test image quality.
gui.llmjs.test.send.tip: Validate and send the displayed form or exact Request JSON through the normal LLM Core Test pipeline.
gui.llmjs.test.simple.tip: Discard the current handoff draft and return to a single user-message DEBUG_TEST request.
gui.llmjs.test.json.mode.tip: Switch between the compact form and the complete Request JSON. Both edit the same unsent ConsoleTestRequest.
gui.llmjs.test.json.editor.tip: The complete request sent to the server, including every message, part, override, and metadata field. Invalid JSON cannot be sent.
gui.llmjs.test.template.previous.tip: Load the previous saved prompt template.
gui.llmjs.test.template.next.tip: Load the next saved prompt template.
gui.llmjs.test.template.save.tip: Save the current prompt text as a local Console template for later tests.
gui.llmjs.test.copy_result.tip: Copy the selected Result text, or the complete Result when nothing is selected. Drag to select; right-click or Ctrl/Cmd+C also copies.
gui.llmjs.test.save_route.tip: Persist the current explicit provider chain and parameter overrides for this purpose. This changes live routing configuration.
gui.llmjs.test.effective_unavailable: No effective route is available for this purpose
gui.llmjs.test.effective.tip: Effective server-side provider and limits after inheritance. T=temperature, out=max output, sec=timeout, in=input budget, res=output reserve.
gui.llmjs.test.result.tip: The exact test result returned to the Console. Drag to select text, scroll for more lines, and right-click or Ctrl/Cmd+C to copy.
gui.llmjs.test.vision.not_supported: provider did not accept the probe
gui.llmjs.log.title: Logs (drag to select; right-click to copy; × deletes one)
gui.llmjs.log.title.tip: Each row is one recorded completion. Drag across rows to compare or export multiple requests together.
gui.llmjs.log.clear.tip: Clear the server's in-memory log history. Provider, routing, and budget data are unchanged.
gui.llmjs.log.delete.tip: Remove this request from the server's in-memory log history.
gui.llmjs.log.mutation.denied: You do not have permission to manage server logs.
gui.llmjs.log.mutation.not_found: That log entry no longer exists; the Console has been refreshed.
gui.llmjs.log.expand.tip: Expand or collapse the long-text request/response reader.
gui.llmjs.log.empty: No log entries yet. LLMjs and linked-mod requests will appear here.
gui.llmjs.log.raw.tip: Shows the exact diagnostic fields, request body, and response body. Drag within the text to copy a precise fragment.
gui.llmjs.setup.name: Name
gui.llmjs.setup.name.tip: Stable provider identifier used by routing. Existing routes refer to this exact name.
gui.llmjs.setup.format.tip: Wire protocol adapter: openai, claude, or gemini. This controls request and response JSON, not the provider name.
gui.llmjs.setup.url.tip: Full chat/completions API endpoint expected by the selected format. Include the provider-required path.
gui.llmjs.setup.model.tip: Exact model identifier sent to the provider, including any provider-specific suffix.
gui.llmjs.setup.api_key.tip: Secret stored in the server configuration. Typed characters are masked. Leave blank while editing to keep the saved key.
gui.llmjs.setup.save.tip: Validate required fields and send this provider configuration to the server. A blank key keeps the existing secret only when editing.
gui.llmjs.setup.clear_key.tip: Clear only the masked key input. This does not delete an already saved server-side key.
gui.llmjs.setup.secret_help: Secrets are server-side. Saved keys are never returned to the client in full.
gui.llmjs.setup.creaturechat_help: CreatureChat uses these providers through purpose routing; configure its prompts in CreatureChat Studio.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.key_field_cleared: Key input cleared; the saved key is unchanged.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.editing_masked: Editing %s; saved key %s will be kept when the field is blank.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.editing_hidden: Editing %s; the saved key will be kept when the field is blank.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.editing_no_key: %s has no saved key; enter one before saving.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.saved: Save request sent for %s with a new key.
gui.llmjs.setup.status.saved_unchanged: Save request sent for %s; saved key unchanged.
gui.llmjs.setup.validation.key_required: API key is required for a new provider.
gui.llmjs.providers.name: Name
gui.llmjs.providers.empty: No providers configured. Add one in Setup.
gui.llmjs.providers.empty.tip: A provider defines the endpoint, protocol format, model, and credential used by routing. Open Setup to create the first one.
gui.llmjs.providers.delete.tip: Delete provider %s from server configuration. Routes that name it must be updated separately.
gui.llmjs.providers.row.tip: %1$s | format=%2$s | model=%3$s | URL=%4$s | key=%5$s. Click to edit.
gui.llmjs.providers.footer: Click a provider to edit it. Right-click the panel to refresh connection status.
gui.llmjs.routing.purpose.tip: A purpose is registered by LLMjs or another mod and identifies a distinct request workflow.
gui.llmjs.routing.provider_chain.tip: Providers are tried from left to right. An empty chain falls back to all configured providers.
gui.llmjs.routing.state.tip: Shows whether the local routing draft matches the last saved server configuration; cfg is its fingerprint.
gui.llmjs.routing.default.tip: Fallback chain used when a purpose has no explicit provider chain. Purpose-specific generation limits still inherit normally.
gui.llmjs.routing.row.tip: ID: %1$s | owner: %2$s | %3$s. Click Edit to change provider priority and overrides.
gui.llmjs.routing.save.tip: Save the complete routing draft to the server. This changes live provider selection and limits.
gui.llmjs.routing.reset.tip: Discard unsaved edits and restore the last server snapshot.
gui.llmjs.routing.refresh.tip: Request a fresh provider, purpose, and routing snapshot from the server.
gui.llmjs.routing.active.tip: Current priority chain. All entries wrap onto additional rows; click a provider to remove it.
gui.llmjs.routing.available.tip: All configured providers are shown across as many rows as needed. [+] adds one; [x] means it is already active.
gui.llmjs.routing.effective: Effective (server): provider=%s T=%s out=%s sec=%s in=%s reserve=%s web=%s
gui.llmjs.routing.effective.tip: Read-only values currently resolved by the server after default, purpose, provider, and context-window limits are combined.
gui.llmjs.routing.parameter_help: Blank = inherit. Input budget is capped by provider context minus output reserve.
gui.llmjs.routing.web_search.tip: Authorizes this purpose to request provider-hosted Web Search. It does not add search to legacy requests or guarantee that the selected provider supports it.
command.llm.whitelist.usage: Usage: /llm whitelist <player> <true|false>. true grants Console administration; false revokes it.
command.llm.whitelist.warning: Only OP level 4, the integrated-server owner, or the server console can change this list. Offline-mode changes require a second confirmation.
command.llm.whitelist.granted: Added %1$s (%2$s) to the Console administrator whitelist.
command.llm.whitelist.revoked: Removed %1$s (%2$s) from the Console administrator whitelist.
command.llm.whitelist.already_granted: %1$s (%2$s) is already a Console administrator; no change was made.
command.llm.whitelist.already_revoked: %1$s (%2$s) is not a whitelisted Console administrator; no change was made.
command.llm.whitelist.missing_uuid: Cannot update %s because no UUID was resolved.
command.llm.whitelist.offline_warning: WARNING: This server uses offline mode. Player names and offline UUIDs can be spoofed unless a trusted external account system prevents it; LLM Core cannot verify that system.
command.llm.whitelist.offline_confirm: No change was made. Repeat the same command within %s seconds to confirm this one operation.
command.llm.whitelist.offline_confirmed: Offline-mode warning acknowledged. This single whitelist change is now being applied.
command.llm.budget.status: %1$s (%2$s): settled=%3$s / limit=%4$s; input=%5$s, output=%6$s, estimated=%7$s, reserved=%8$s; state=%9$s; source=%10$s
command.llm.budget.default_set: Default personal budget set to %s tokens. This also confirms the server policy.
command.llm.budget.default_unlimited: Default personal budget set to unlimited. Usage recording remains enabled, and the server policy is confirmed.
command.llm.budget.default_disabled: Default personal budget set to disabled. Players need an explicit override before using LLM features.
command.llm.budget.default_confirmed: Confirmed the current default personal budget policy.
command.llm.budget.confirm_warning: PERSONAL AI BUDGETS DEFAULT TO UNLIMITED ON THIS SERVER.
command.llm.budget.confirm_hint: Review the policy, then run /llm budget confirm-default or choose a new /llm budget default value.
command.llm.budget.player_set: Set %1$s (%2$s) to a personal budget of %3$s tokens.
command.llm.budget.player_unlimited: Set %1$s (%2$s) to an explicit unlimited personal budget.
command.llm.budget.player_inherit: Cleared the override for %1$s (%2$s); the server default now applies.
command.llm.budget.reset_empty: %1$s (%2$s) has no personal token usage to reset.
command.llm.budget.storage_unavailable: Personal token usage storage is unavailable. No budget records were changed.
